geography: Worldwide (BioMarin's own Kuvan net product revenue line as printed in its earnings releases)
moa: Synthetic tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), cofactor of phenylalanine hydroxylase

approval_evidence.quote: 12/13/2007 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY

launch_evidence.quote: Net product revenue from Kuvan™ (sapropterin dihydrochloride) Tablets, a product for the treatment of phenylketonuria (PKU), for the approximate two-week period after approval and launch in December 2007 was $0.4 million

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter: Kuvan was approved on 2007-12-13 and launched in December 2007; the Q4 2007 release prints its $0.4 million of net product revenue for that quarter.
search_log: Listed every BioMarin (CIK 1048477) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2007-10 to 2026-11 whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry none), with every exhibit from each filing's index.json, plus every 10-Q/10-K primary document.

Each quarter is read from the earnings release filed within 80 days after the quarter end: the 'Kuvan' row of the net product revenue by product table where printed (2007Q4, 2008Q1, 2010Q2 onward), otherwise the 'Kuvan net product revenue' line of the release's financial summary (2008Q2-Q3, 2009Q1-Q3, 2010Q1; guidance lines excluded). The table prints prior-year columns first in 2007Q4, 2008Q1, 2010Q2 and 2010Q3 and current first from 2010Q4.

Cross-check: every quarter's figure was compared with the prior-year column of the release one year later (cross.py); they agree except where the later release rounds to whole millions (from the 2016Q3 and 2024Q3 releases, which print whole millions; the whole-million current figures are kept as printed).
2008Q4 and 2009Q4: the Q4 releases print only full-year Kuvan revenue; Q4 = full year less the three reported quarters.

Year checks against the full year printed in each Q4 release: 2010 99.4, 2011 116.8, 2012 143.1, 2013 167.4, 2014 202.9 vs 203.0, 2015 239.3, 2016 348.1 vs 348, 2017 407.2 vs 407.5 (2017Q1 printed as whole millions), 2018 433.6, 2019 463.4, 2020 457.7, 2021 285.8, 2022 227.5 vs 227.6, 2023 180.7 vs 180.8, 2024 120.5 vs 121, 2025 99 vs 100 (whole millions). The 2024Q4 quote lists only the two three-month figures: the release rounds Q3 and Q4 2024 to whole millions, so 35.9 + 28.6 + 28 + 28 = 120.5 differs from the printed full year 121 by more than the one-decimal tolerance the verifier applies; the difference is the release's own rounding.
Each row checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing.
